json.headline: Why Gas in California Is Almost $6 a Gallon — and Could Go Higher
json.author: Matthew Zeitlin
summary_bullets: War with Iran adds to a long list of factors making California gas expensive
California's gasoline market is a world all its own, with consistently higher prices than anywhere else in the U.S.
The state's gas price has risen to $5.62 per gallon, up from $4.59 a month ago
key_claims: The average gasoline price in California has risen to $5.62 per gallon
The state's gas price is consistently higher than anywhere else in the U.S.
The war with Iran is contributing to the high gas prices in California
